A1_stream_integrity.rule: FusionRunner final alarms and events (start, end, blamed, response, explanation) equal SystemV2.run on the same per-domain arrays for every attack composite and every clean timeline (0 mismatches)

A2_coverage.rule: every test episode enumerated from the SOURCES (70 per KITTI vehicle type, 32 per comma type, 7 per LiDAR per-scan kind, 21 per LiDAR episode kind, every CAN / V2X / network attack run) is a composite; no difference between expected and built counts

A3_live_cosimulation.rule: at least 6 composites driven fully live through the runners and the bus equal the replay from the stored domain passes (0 mismatches)

A4_timing.rule: per-domain compute latency (median, p95, p99), Evidence delay, real-time ratio and a keeps-up statement, all from measured passes

A5_completeness.rule: every reported item exists in S2_results.json (by type, by domain, blame, response, clean hours with CI, timing, v2 side by side)

B1_clean_tick_fa.rule: clean raw tick FA <= 3.0% (K and C)

B2_events_per_clean_hour.rule: alert events per clean hour <= 10 (K and C)

B3_event_detection_single.rule: K mean event detection over the single-domain attack types >= 70%

B4_heldout_types.rule: K mean event detection over the S4 held-out types >= 60%

B5_blame.rule: K blame of detected single-domain events, equal weight per attack type: correct >= 75% and wrong <= 10% (the pooled value is dominated by V2X episodes and is reported next to it)

B6_safe_stop_per_clean_hour.rule: SAFE_STOP recommendations per clean hour <= 1 (K and C)

B7_explanations.rule: 100% of alert events carry the system's explanation

M3_verdict.rule: M3 = MET only if A1-A5 and B1-B7 all hold
